description: This file defines a Twig token parser class for handling the 'flush' tag, which triggers output flushing in Twig templates.

classes.name: FlushTokenParser
classes.description: Final class that extends AbstractTokenParser to parse 'flush' tags in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'flush' tag and returns a FlushNode.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string 'flush', which is the tag name this parser handles.
